verdict.rationale: The runtime probe of jo's llms.txt notes that it documents 'ZDR model routing' (zero-data-retention), which implies user data sent to model providers is not retained and so not used for training. That is only a single passing mention, with no explicit no-training policy and no user-facing control. Per-user isolated machines (jo-docs-13) address data separation, not training use. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that user data is never used for model training, a user-facing opt-out or control, details of how ZDR routing works and which providers it covers, and independent corroboration.
